verdict.rationale: Circle provides official REST APIs plus Web/Mobile SDKs (Android/iOS) for wallets, alongside a dedicated Agent Stack (Agent Wallets, Bridge Kit SDK, CLI, MCP server) explicitly built for AI-native/agentic use cases. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality and a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), so evidence relies solely on vendor docs.
